task: Get ready to pick stuff up and put it in places, because you've just entered TextWorld! Your first objective is to go south. And then, venture south. And then, try to go south. And then, try to travel west. Then, look and see that the stone hatch within the workshop is ajar. And then, attempt to head west. Then, lift the printer from the floor of the studio. Once that's all handled, you can stop!
